csv_project_name: AE Services for Public Works Central Stores Warehouse
csv_scope_of_work: The County is requesting proposals from qualified firms for the provision of Professional Architectural and Engineering Services for the new Manatee County Public Works Central Stores Warehouse Building project. Design for the construction of a new approximately +28,000 square foot Central Stores/Surplus Warehouse facility for county-wide logistics and asset management along with a cabinet shop. It will also include parking, security measures, hurricane hardened, a generator disconnect, offices, and storage areas and site work. The objective of this solicitation is to provide all planning, design, permitting, cost options, and project management for the Manatee County Public Works Central Stores Warehouse which will be constructed at the following location: Manatee County Public Works Fleet Maintenance Facility 1707 Lena Road Bradenton, FL 34211
